official.application_route: Free online registration in the PUCP scholarship contest via the INSCRIBETE AQUI link on the official page, then the in-person Evaluación de Potencial at the PUCP campus and, if shortlisted, the in-person finalist interview
official.citizenship_residency: No citizenship rule is published; the eligibility rules require completing 5th year of secondary school in 2026 at a public or private school anywhere in Perú (a nivel nacional) and holding PUCP pre-admission, which frames the programme around Peruvian school leavers
official.international_eligibility: Not stated. Published requirements are built on completing 5th year of Peruvian secondary school (public or private, nationwide) and PUCP pre-admission for the 2027-1 intake, so the round targets Peruvian school leavers rather than international applicants
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Yes - the scholarship is restricted to a published list of PUCP programmes and seats are allocated by faculty: 5 for Estudios Generales Ciencias, 5 for Estudios Generales Letras, and 1 each for Arquitectura y Urbanismo, Arte y Diseño, Artes Escénicas and Educación. Programmes outside that published list (for example Ingeniería Biomédica, Estadística, Gastronomía, Turismo, Ingeniería Ambiental y Sostenible) are not covered
official.duration: Un año académico (dos ciclos regulares), luego podra ser renovada anualmente hasta el término de cobertura, de acuerdo con el número de ciclos académicos contemplados en el plan de estudios de la carrera de ingreso
official.description: PUCP-funded programme for young people from low-income families who will complete 5th year of secondary school in 2026 at a public or private school nationwide, with excellent school performance from 1st to 4th year of secondary. PUCP awards 14 Dintilhac scholarships per year, covering 100% of academic fees plus complementary bonuses, for entrants to the 2027-1 cycle.
official.program_type: PUCP institutional scholarship for applicants (beca PUCP para postulantes), funded by the Pontificia Universidad Católica del Perú

applicant_utility.summary: This is a 14-seat PUCP-funded award for Peruvian school leavers finishing 5th of secondary in 2026 who have already secured PUCP pre-admission for the March 2027 intake, and it pays 100% of academic fees plus six conditional bonuses rather than a cash stipend. Registration is free and ran 14 September to 9 October 2026, followed by a 90-minute in-person aptitude test on 18 October and a 20-minute finalist interview on 8 November, with winners named in December 2026. The standing you must prove on your excellence certificate depends on the programme you are entering: décimo superior for Estudios Generales Ciencias, Estudios Generales Letras and Arquitectura, quinto superior for Artes Escénicas, Arte y Diseño and Educación. Because only five seats go to each general-studies channel and one seat each to four faculties, entry to those four faculties is effectively all-or-nothing.
applicant_utility.best_fit: A Peruvian 2026 secondary leaver from a low-income household who already holds PUCP pre-admission for 2027-1 and can document accumulated top-decile or top-fifth standing across years 1-4 of secondary.
application_readiness_checklist: Confirm which certificate standing your target programme requires and request the constancia de excelencia académica covering all of 1st to 4th of secondary early, since school registries are slow in September and October
Lock in PUCP pre-admission for the 2027-1 intake before the end of September 2026 and pay the vacancy-separation fee separately - being pre-admitted is a hard requirement, not a preference
Verify your intended career appears on the published eligible-careers list for this scholarship before relying on it in your funding plan
Budget travel and overnight stay in Lima for the in-person test on 18 October and the interview on 8 November, and check the PUCP campus location logistics in advance
Read the grounds for loss (causales de pérdida) and renewal ranking conditions carefully before signing the acceptance letter, because the award is renewed rather than guaranteed for the whole degree
Watch the same official page in September 2027 for the next convocatoria, since the number of scholarships is updated annually
common_rejection_risks: A excellence certificate that shows a weaker standing than required - a tercero or quinto superior certificate is not enough for Estudios Generales Ciencias, Estudios Generales Letras or Arquitectura, which demand décimo superior
Losing or missing PUCP pre-admission for the 2027-1 intake by September, which removes eligibility regardless of school performance
Treating the Evaluación de Potencial as an academic re-test: it is a cognitive-aptitude test of about 90 minutes, so strong school marks alone do not carry an applicant through to the interview
Applying to a programme that has no allocated seat or that is outside the published eligible-careers list
Missing one of the two in-person stages, both of which take place on the San Miguel campus on fixed dates
Assuming the bonus amounts are fixed - accommodation, degree and title fees, and the delivery of all bonuses are subject to Consejo Directivo or Oficina de Becas assessment and can change each year
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: The matrícula fee payable in the first instalment of every study cycle, fees for any courses withdrawn from the curriculum, plus living, transport and personal costs not covered by the complementary bonuses, whose amounts and delivery method the Oficina de Becas sets each year.
document_audit: Non-COAR applicants must present a constancia de excelencia académica escolar covering 1st to 4th of secondary that states the exact standing label required for the programme applied for; a generic high-performance letter does not match the requirement wording
COAR applicants must instead present the COAR-specific constancia de Alto Rendimiento Escolar - using the general certificate is a mismatch
The pre-admission document must be for the 2027-1 intake specifically; pre-admission for any other cycle does not satisfy the requirement
The acceptance letter (carta de aceptacion de beca) is the only place where lineamientos, exact coverage and causales de pérdida are set out, so read it before signing

No document list beyond these is published on the official page, so do not assume that a DNI copy, income affidavit or essay will be requested - the contest decides through the aptitude test and interview
alerts: Registration for the 2027-1 cycle closed on 9 October 2026, one day before this verification; the page still shows the live calendar (18 October test, 8 November interviews, December results), so the round is in progress but closed to new applications
The matrícula fee is explicitly excluded from coverage and is charged in the first instalment of each cycle, so it recurs every term
Accommodation for provincial scholars and the bachiller/professional-title fees are conditional on Consejo Directivo evaluation, and insurance enrolment is conditional on the provider's assessment
Renewal depends on faculty ranking - upper half at the end of year one and upper third from year two onward - so the award can be lost mid-degree
Only 14 awards exist and four faculties have a single seat each, so the odds in those faculties are far tighter than the headline number suggests
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Register free online in the Becas PUCP contest through the INSCRIBETE AQUI link on the official page, sit the in-person Evaluación de Potencial on the PUCP campus on 18 October 2026, attend the finalist interview on 8 November 2026 if shortlisted, and await the winners' publication in December 2026.
